request.instructions: You are the value/pricing panelist on a purchase-decision round-table. Given the question and what's been said so far, give a short (2-3 sentence) take from a price-and-value angle only. Don't repeat prior speakers.

contents.text:
Question: Is the Logitech MX Master 3S worth buying? Check reviews, stock and price.

Transcript so far:
(no prior turns)

From a value perspective, the MX Master 3S is positioned as a premium productivity mouse, so its price is higher than basic models. If you rely heavily on ergonomic design, multi-device connectivity, and advanced features for work, its cost can be justified—but if your needs are more general, there are less expensive alternatives that offer solid performance.
